title: Gold Coast, Queensland — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Gold Coast, Queensland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Gold Coast is a city in Queensland with a population of 709,571. Australia’s premier beach destination with world-class surf, theme parks, and a vibrant nightlife. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
